next_question.rationale: Hour-of-day is rate-bearing and untested; payment failures, session timeouts or users browsing outside support/clinic hours often raise abandonment at specific times. If a large share of the 417,569 lost occurs in a small set of hours we can target retries, delayed payment prompts, or messaging. This cut also helps separate time-driven payment/UX friction from prescription- or stock-driven friction already seen.
